note: Editor toolbar buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for editing actions (e.g., Undo, Redo, Cut, Copy, Paste, Find, Replace, etc.)
Editor toolbar toggle buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for view/edit modes (e.g., Word Wrap, Show Line Numbers, etc.)
Editor toolbar checkboxes -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for feature toggles (e.g., Highlight Syntax, etc.)
Editor toolbar radio buttons -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for mode selection (e.g., Normal, Insert, Overwrite)
Editor status bar labels -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document metrics (e.g., Ln, Col, Encoding, EOL)
Editor status bar container -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for document state
Tab bar container -- renders fixed operator vocabulary for tab management controls (e.g., Close, New Tab)
